source_review: Inspected all ten changed files and actual surrounding ownership, import recovery, schema and runtime invariant code.

Launcher prepare requires the authenticated prepare permission and operation owner; shared control-store slot must exist and match the owner. Supplied owner identifiers cannot fall through to legacy activation.

Canonical operation digest, project, published intent, request identity, repository binding, manifest commit/hash and source commit are checked and recorded. Changed published ref fails before import registration.

Preparation parks the attempt and returns before runtime resource planning, activation or initial assignments. Manual is Waiting and auto is Prepared. Parked attempts are excluded from autonomous startup recovery; legacy start cannot consume their held reservation.

Cancellation requires stop permission and ownership and proves the runtime never activated, with no workflow or assignments and no actual process/port/branch ownership. It preserves history and files and releases only the stopped operation reservation.

Cancellation evidence is cross-bound to the failed owned import and exact stop timestamp. Runtime v1/v2 and invariant checks reject absent or forged proof; ordinary terminal failure evidence remains required.

Quota and TTL are server-side bounds frozen at reservation. Expired or failed preparation retains reservation and history and cannot activate. Exact preparation replay is supported; broader failed-import continuation remains fail-closed and deferred.

tests.suite: independent stdin unittest using disposable local Git fixture
assertions: Real prepared then stopped state passes both runtime v1 and v2 schemas and activation invariants.
Removing cancellation proof causes schema rejection and TERMINAL_FAILURE_EVIDENCE_MISSING.
Setting never_activated false causes schema rejection and PREPARATION_CANCELLATION_INVALID.

limitations: No live Telegram Bot or model calls were made. Publication uses disposable local Git.
Authorized Start, executor acknowledgement, active stop and owner-bound failed-import retry continuation belong to launch-modes and are not approved as implemented by this stage.
New PREPARED records require upgraded schema-aware readers; older binaries are documented as unsupported once these records exist.

decision_request.feedback: APPROVE for instance-preparation result 75549ce4e7390cad53b7980bab9696a88d304120 only. Independent read-only review found no blocking security/evidence issue in this stage. 56 independent checks passed: 46 sprint contracts, 9 focused preparation tests, and 1 actual cancellation proof/forgery probe covering runtime schemas v1 and v2. Verified owner-held reservation and immutable published manifest/source binding, legacy/startup activation denial, preparation receipts with no assignments or activation, stop-authorized never-activated cancellation, preserved history/new namespace, expiry and quota failure closure. Authorized Start, executor ACK/active stop, and owner-bound failed-import retry remain next-stage gates; failed retry currently retains its reservation and cannot activate. No live Bot/model/external service validation is claimed.
